name: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Implement image processing algorithms, feature detection, and neural network inference for vision tasks. Optimize for embedded cameras.
dictum_features: Edge AI module for NN inference
example_snippet:
program EdgeDetector:
    shape Image holds:
        Pixels as raw handle to byte
        Width as whole number
        Height as whole number
    end shape

    action sobel_x takes Img as const ref Image, X as whole number, Y as whole number produces whole number:
        # Simplified Sobel X kernel
        keep Sum as whole number with value 0

        unsafe:
            keep Ptr as * byte
            put transmute Img.Pixels as * byte into Ptr

            keep Idx as whole number
            put the sum of the product of Y and Img.Width and X into Idx
            keep Val as whole number
            put Index at Idx of Ptr into Val
            put the sum of Sum and Val into Sum
        end unsafe

        produce success with Sum
    end action

    keep Img as Image with nothing and 640 and 480
    print the text "Sobel edge detector initialized for 640x480" and newline
end program
status_note: C++ backend active (C++17/20/23, CI-tested). OpenCV/camera frame buffer access requires C imports.
